bio_md:
# 辽兴宗耶律宗真 · 主要事迹

耶律宗真（1016—1055），[[liao-sheng-zong|圣宗]]长子，太平十一年（1031）即位，改元景福，次年重熙。

兴宗好文艺、慕汉学，诗文书画俱佳，然政事平平。重熙十一年（1042）乘宋夏交战之机，向宋索关南十县之地，宋增岁币以和；重熙十三年（1044）亲征西夏，河曲之役不果而还。晚年与弟重元构隙，留下储位隐患。

重熙二十四年（1055）兴宗崩，长子耶律洪基即位，是为[[liao-dao-zong|辽道宗]]。辽之势由盛转平，实始于兴宗。

bio_parts_en.value:
, ascended in 1031, era Jingfu, then Chongxi.

Xingzong loved letters - poetry, painting, calligraphy - but governed flatly. In 1042, taking advantage of the Song-Xia war, he pressed Song for the ten Guannan counties and received increased tribute instead. In 1044 he campaigned against Western Xia in person; the Hequ campaign came to nothing. His later years bred suspicion against his brother Chongyuan, leaving a succession fault line.

He died in 1055; his eldest son Yelü Hongji became
. Liao's slide from its peak began under Xingzong.
